items.summary: 目前內測已套用的統一像素角色圖。Ninja Council 3 僅作比例、輪廓與動作語彙研究；本圖重新繪製，未複製或擷取遊戲圖。
improvements: 角色與技能使用同一美術家族。

items.title: 我愛羅・共通與方向動作
items.kind: 原創重繪・AI 輔助製作
items.summary: 原創重新繪製，與鳴人、佐助、小李共用像素比例、輪廓與逐格裁切流程。Ninja Council 3 僅作風格與動作語彙研究。
improvements: 遊戲與審閱室共用實際裁切與腳底錨點。
施術姿勢配合真正的砂彈、束縛、砂盾與範圍葬擊。
limitations: 正背面待機各兩張；左向由右向鏡射。技能使用右向施術姿勢，向左時鏡射；砂粒與範圍特效由遊戲繪製。

references.title: 原創製作來源與提示紀錄

items.title: tenten-common-v1
items.kind: original AI redraw
items.summary: 32 original poses: front/back/side idle, directional movement and hurt, genuine collapse and basic throw.
improvements: Genuine separate poses, with fixed standing body scale.
Alpha crop and foot anchor registration; left uses explicit mirroring.
limitations: Side-only attacks use a documented right-facing fallback for vertical aim.

items.title: tenten-skills-v1
items.kind: original AI redraw
items.summary: 16 original poses for Fuma prepare/release/catch/recovery, explosive tags, twin scrolls and tool mastery.
improvements: Genuine separate poses, with fixed standing body scale.
Alpha crop and foot anchor registration; left uses explicit mirroring.
limitations: Side-only attacks use a documented right-facing fallback for vertical aim.

items.title: lee-bandage-v1
items.kind: original AI redraw
items.summary: Eight original wrist-unwind, cast, reel and tension poses across normal/opened gates forms; measured wrist grips attach the cloth.
improvements: Genuine separate poses, with fixed standing body scale.
Alpha crop and foot anchor registration; left uses explicit mirroring.
limitations: Side-only attacks use a documented right-facing fallback for vertical aim.

items.title: Tenten twin-scroll empty-hand release
items.kind: original AI redraw
items.summary: Four open-hand toss, rise, apex and landing poses for detached physical scrolls.
improvements: Four original poses with one standing body scale.
Measured open-palm anchors for both independently released scrolls.
limitations: Side-facing poses use explicit mirroring and vertical fallback.
